steps.content: [Several 3D night scenes are disrupted by glitches]
You regain consciousness. You're not in the phone, and you don't have the protection of the "low-dimensional filter". You feel dizzy and nauseous, but you haven't lost all mobility.
The area is being ravaged by the Mania storm, and its eye is the Sinner going manic in the sky.
Haha, outta my way!
Her body keeps disintegrating, but she doesn't care. She keeps lashing out vengefully, tearing through the sky with her halo blade as she falls.
These aren't gods' permissions; it's her own Sinner power, the power of Mania. The entire city's power supply is affected. Lights flicker, and you can hear the puzzled murmurs of the crowd.
You remember a similar incident not long ago, when she said...
This round doesn't count. Someone violated the game rules by overusing Mania and got discovered.
Next... hehe, the consequences should be exciting.
Now you know what the consequences are.
Square holes burst through her body, and the scattered data quickly dissipate. The attack is so swift, giving her no time to react.

You can't see where the attack came from, but you recall what happened when you first used the shackles to release Mania and forced 000 to launch a rewind: an invisible enemy, an unstoppable attack, and a fierce reaction to Mania...
...This is the real reason she has been constantly rewinding: the so-called "game rules."
But this time, she has no strength left to initiate a rewind or avoid the attack. Another invisible force strikes 000, making her fall from the sky.
You rush to her side. You must use your shackles to stop her from getting herself killed like this.
[Release the shackles]
The shackles take effect, and the Forbidden Force kicks in. Red lights pierce through her body, inflicting even more pain on the already weakened girl. You grit your teeth and help her up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No matter what you want, this isn't the way. You can't change the world like this. Can't you try something else? You can keep rewinding, and if that doesn't work... aren't you great at hiding Sinners?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That character file won't do anything to you. No one can...
Mmph!
As you speak, her body trembles. Her already broken form distorts and reconstitutes, flashing through countless strange appearances in an instant, cutting off your words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Or, we can find Moore, and find the "god" who rewrote your file. If you don't want to be altered, then decide what identity you want yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At least we can get you stabilized.

She looks at you in a daze, then closes her eyes and hugs herself tightly, quivering non-stop. Dense data flow out from her fingertips, slowly repairing her damaged body. After a while, she finally regains her voice.
But what comes out is a faintly manic laugh.
...Haha... hahaha! Never!
The shackles dissolve in an instant. Only then do you realize that she still has the "gods'" permissions, easily removing your shackles.
Another impact strikes. 000 pushes you away, dodging a hit and also distancing herself from you.
Three halo blades converge in her palm again. She looks up at you one last time, smiles, then charges towards the unseen enemy in the sky.
